annotation_policy.recall_definition: Recall@k = retrieved relevant chunks in top-k divided by total relevant chunks for that question.
annotation_policy.mrr_definition: Mean reciprocal rank of the first relevant chunk.
annotation_policy.note: Experimental V3 Gold labels: original Gold IDs plus manually reviewed and approved additions. This is not the finalized official benchmark.
